name: v2-1-80-demo-plugin
description: Demo plugin exercising every Claude Code v2.1.80+ feature: Monitor tool, userConfig (5-type whitelist), channels, CLAUDE_PLUGIN_OPTION_<KEY> env vars, and the v2.1.98 plugin-skill name field.

WORKSPACE_DIR.title: Workspace directory
WORKSPACE_DIR.description: Absolute path to the user's workspace directory.

API_TOKEN.title: API authentication token
API_TOKEN.description: Bearer token routed to the system keychain (sensitive=true).

POLL_INTERVAL.title: Poll interval (seconds)
POLL_INTERVAL.description: How often to poll upstream events.

ENABLE_CACHE.title: Enable cache
ENABLE_CACHE.description: Whether to cache results between runs.

CONFIG_FILE.title: Config file path
CONFIG_FILE.description: Absolute path to the plugin's configuration file.
